observations: Photo 0, 1, 2: A blue PlayStation 4 Slim console wrapped in clear plastic film, with a 'Days of Play' style icon design (triangle, circle, square, X) printed on the lid.
Photo 1 and 2: A camouflage-pattern DualShock 4 controller sits next to or on the console.
PlayStation logo visible on the console's top left corner in photo 1 and 2.
No power cable, HDMI cable, original box, or any game discs/cases are visible in any photo.
No serial number, model number plate, or rear port panel is shown in any photo.
Watermark 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' overlaid on all three photos, suggesting a reseller/dealer listing rather than a private owner's own photos.
The console is not powered on in any photo; no boot screen, home screen, or any functional test is shown.

identity.kind: PS4 Slim console (limited-edition 'Days of Play' style design) with one controller

claims.evidence: Photos show a factory-style 'Days of Play' limited edition shell design, not a visibly hand-customised unit; no proof of aftermarket customisation versus a standard special edition.
No game discs, cases, or digital library screen are visible in any of the 3 photos; only the console and one controller are shown.

PES as a franchise was discontinued and rebranded to eFootball starting in 2021, and no title named 'PES 2027' exists; this claim could not correspond to any real game, and no game media is shown in any photo.

risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on to the home screen, and a clip showing a disc loading or digital game launching
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / non-functional unit

risks.risk: No accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, box) confirmed present
risks.proof: A photo showing the power brick, HDMI cable, and original box together with the console

risks.risk: Claimed games are not actually included or do not exist as described
risks.proof: A photo of the console's game library/home screen showing installed titles, or physical game cases with visible covers
risks.if_unproven: priced as console and controller only, no games included

risks.risk: 'Customised' claim may be a mislabel for a standard special edition shell, affecting perceived rarity value
risks.proof: Any proof of aftermarket modification (custom internals, non-factory finish close-up) versus confirmation it is the standard retail special edition
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard special-edition shell, not custom

risks.risk: Hidden wear or damage under the plastic wrap (scratches, cracks) not visible due to glare and film
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each panel with the plastic wrap removed, in good lighting
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cosmetic condition is only as good as currently visible, with possible hidden flaws

proof_requests: A video of the console powering on, loading a game, and running the camo controller to confirm function
A clear photo of the included games (physical cases or a digital library screen) to confirm the '10 latest games' and refute or support the impossible 'PES 2027' title
A photo of all included accessories: power cable, HDMI cable, box
A close-up of the rear port panel and serial number plate to confirm authenticity and model
response.reason: The seller claims inclusion of 'PES 2027,' a title that does not and cannot exist since the PES franchise was discontinued and rebranded years ago, which is a strong sign of a fabricated or copy-pasted listing; combined with zero evidence of any games, cables, or a working unit in the photos, this listing shows clear signs of misrepresentation.
